qEn: What is the SI unit of electric charge?
qHi: विद्युत आवेश का एसआई (SI) मात्रक क्या है?
explainEn: The SI unit of electric charge is the coulomb, named after the French physicist Charles-Augustin de Coulomb.

qEn: Which functional group represents an aldehyde?
qHi: कौन सा क्रियात्मक समूह एल्डिहाइड को दर्शाता है?
explainEn: The aldehyde group consists of a carbon atom bonded to a hydrogen atom and double-bonded to an oxygen atom, written as -CHO.

qEn: Who wrote the historical novel 'Ain-i-Akbari'?
qHi: ऐतिहासिक ग्रंथ 'आईना-ए-अकबरी' के लेखक कौन हैं?
explainEn: Ain-i-Akbari is the third volume of the 16th-century document Akbarnama, written by Mughal court historian Abul Fazl.

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution abolishes untouchability?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद अस्पृश्यता का अंत करता है?
explainEn: Article 17 of the Constitution of India abolishes 'untouchability' and forbids its practice in any form.
sourceHint: Indian Constitution / NCERT Class 11 Political Science

qEn: What type of economy is characterized by the coexistence of both public and private sectors?
qHi: सार्वजनिक और निजी दोनों क्षेत्रों के सह-अस्तित्व वाली अर्थव्यवस्था को क्या कहा जाता है?
explainEn: A mixed economy features characteristics of both capitalism and socialism, allowing both private enterprise and state intervention.

qEn: Which greenhouse gas is emitted primarily by paddy fields and ruminant livestock?
qHi: मुख्य रूप से धान के खेतों और जुगाली करने वाले पशुओं द्वारा कौन सी ग्रीनहाउस गैस उत्सर्जित होती है?
explainEn: Methane is produced anaerobically in flooded paddy fields and through enteric fermentation in ruminants like cows and buffaloes.

qEn: What is the term for a market structure with a single seller and no close substitutes?
qHi: एक ऐसे बाजार ढांचे को क्या कहा जाता है जिसमें एक ही विक्रेता होता है और जिसका कोई निकट विकल्प नहीं होता?
explainEn: Monopoly is defined by a single supplier dominating an entire market with unique goods or services and high barriers to entry.

qEn: Which organelle is known as the powerhouse of the cell?
qHi: किस कोशिकांग को कोशिका का ऊर्जा गृह कहा जाता है?
explainEn: Mitochondria generate most of the chemical energy needed to power the cell's biochemical reactions.

qEn: Which of the following is a noble gas?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी एक उत्कृष्ट गैस है?
explainEn: Helium is a chemical element with symbol He and atomic number 2, belonging to the noble gases group.

qEn: Who wrote the historical book 'Ain-i-Akbari'?
qHi: ऐतिहासिक ग्रंथ 'आईने अकबरी' किसने लिखा था?
explainEn: Ain-i-Akbari is the 16th-century detailed document recording the administration of the Mughal Empire under Emperor Akbar, written by his vizier, Abul Fazl.

qEn: What is the primary sector of an economy mainly associated with?
qHi: अर्थव्यवस्था का प्राथमिक क्षेत्र मुख्य रूप से किससे संबंधित है?
explainEn: The primary sector involves extracting and harvesting natural products, such as agriculture, forestry, and fishing.

qEn: Which state in India is the largest producer of sugarcane?
qHi: भारत में गन्ने का सबसे बड़ा उत्पादक राज्य कौन सा है?
explainEn: Uttar Pradesh is the leading producer of sugarcane in India, followed by Maharashtra.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Geography, India People and Economy

qEn: Which part of the human brain controls balance and posture?
qHi: मानव मस्तिष्क का कौन सा भाग संतुलन और मुद्रा को नियंत्रित करता है?
explainEn: The cerebellum receives information from the sensory systems and coordinates voluntary movements such as posture, balance, and speech.

qEn: Which organelle is considered the primary site for the synthesis of lipids in eukaryotic cells?
qHi: यूकैरियोटिक कोशिकाओं में लिपिड के संश्लेषण के लिए कौन सा अंगक प्राथमिक स्थल माना जाता है?
explainEn: The smooth endoplasmic reticulum lacks ribosomes on its surface and is dedicated to lipid and steroid hormone synthesis.

qEn: What is the SI unit of magnetic flux?
qHi: चुंबकीय फ्लक्स की एसआई इकाई क्या है?
explainEn: The SI unit of magnetic flux is the Weber (Wb), named after the German physicist Wilhelm Eduard Weber.

qEn: Which functional group is characteristic of aldehydes?
qHi: कौन सा कार्यात्मक समूह एल्डिहाइड की विशेषता है?
explainEn: Aldehydes are characterized by the presence of a formyl group, which is represented as -CHO.

qEn: Which Article of the Indian Constitution abolishes 'Untouchability' and forbids its practice in any form?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'अस्पृश्यता' को समाप्त करता है और किसी भी रूप में इसके अभ्यास पर प्रतिबंध लगाता है?
explainEn: Article 17 of the Indian Constitution abolishes untouchability and makes its practice a punishable offense under law.

qEn: In which year was the first complete census conducted in British India?
qHi: ब्रिटिश भारत में पहली बार संपूर्ण जनगणना किस वर्ष की गई थी?
explainEn: While a non-synchronous census began in 1872, the first complete and synchronized decennial census in British India was conducted in 1881.

qEn: What type of economy is characterized by the central planning authority taking all major economic decisions?
qHi: किस प्रकार की अर्थव्यवस्था की विशेषता केंद्रीय योजना प्राधिकरण द्वारा सभी प्रमुख आर्थिक निर्णय लेना है?
explainEn: In a centrally planned economy, all important decisions regarding production and distribution are made by the government or a central authority.

qEn: Which of the following processes converts atmospheric nitrogen into ammonia by living organisms?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी प्रक्रिया जीवित जीवों द्वारा वायुमंडलीय नाइट्रोजन को अमोनिया में परिवर्तित करती है?
explainEn: Biological nitrogen fixation is the process by which atmospheric nitrogen is reduced to ammonia by microorganisms possessing the enzyme nitrogenase.

qEn: Which protocol, signed in 1987, aims to phase out substances that deplete the ozone layer?
qHi: 1987 में हस्ताक्षरित कौन सा प्रोटोकॉल ओजोन परत को क्षीण करने वाले पदार्थों को चरणबद्ध तरीके से समाप्त करने का लक्ष्य रखता है?
explainEn: The Montreal Protocol is an international treaty designed to protect the ozone layer by phasing out the production of numerous substances responsible for ozone depletion.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Geography, Chapter 9 / Class 12 Biology

qEn: Which of the following is a key feature of a federal system of government?
qHi: सरकार की संघीय प्रणाली की निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी एक प्रमुख विशेषता है?
optsEn: Concentration of power in the central government
Division of powers between the centre and the states
optsHi: केंद्रीय सरकार में सत्ता का संकेंद्रण
केंद्र और राज्यों के बीच शक्तियों का विभाजन
explainEn: Federalism involves the division of powers between a central authority and constituent units like states.

qEn: What is the primary function of the Reserve Bank of India?
qHi: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
optsEn: Regulating the issuance of currency and monetary policy
Fixing agricultural support prices for farmers
Directly collecting income tax from citizens
Managing municipal elections in urban areas
optsHi: मुद्रा जारी करने और मौद्रिक नीति को विनियमित करना
किसानों के लिए कृषि समर्थन मूल्य तय करना
नागरिकों से सीधे आयकर एकत्र करना
शहरी क्षेत्रों में नगरपालिका चुनाव प्रबंधित करना
explainEn: The Reserve Bank of India is the central bank responsible for currency issuance and regulating monetary policy.

qEn: Which element is the primary basis for organic chemistry compounds?
qHi: कार्बनिक रसायन विज्ञान के यौगिकों के लिए कौन सा तत्व प्राथमिक आधार है?
explainEn: Carbon is the fundamental building block of all organic compounds due to its tetravalency and catenation properties.

qEn: In physics, what is the SI unit of electrical resistance?
qHi: भौतिकी में, विद्युत प्रतिरोध की एसआई इकाई क्या है?
explainEn: The ohm is the SI derived unit of electrical resistance, named after Georg Ohm.

qEn: Which Harappan site is well known for its dockyard structure?
qHi: कौन सा हड़प्पा स्थल अपनी गोदी (डॉकिंग यार्ड) संरचना के लिए अच्छी तरह से जाना जाता है?
explainEn: Lothal features a massive brick basin identified as a tidal dockyard by archaeologists.

qEn: What does GDP stand for in macroeconomics?
qHi: मैक्रोइकॉनॉमिक्स में जीडीपी (GDP) का क्या अर्थ है?
explainEn: GDP stands for Gross Domestic Product, measuring the total monetary value of finished goods and services.

qEn: Which part of the Indian Constitution contains the Directive Principles of State Policy?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान के किस भाग में राज्य के नीति निर्देशक तत्व शामिल हैं?
explainEn: Part IV of the Indian Constitution, from Article 36 to 51, contains the Directive Principles of State Policy.

qEn: In a zero-order reaction, the rate of the reaction is proportional to which power of the reactant concentration?
qHi: शून्य कोटि की अभिक्रिया में, अभिक्रिया की दर अभिकारक की सांद्रता की किस घात के समानुपाती होती है?
explainEn: By definition, the rate of a zero-order reaction is independent of the concentration of the reactants, meaning it is proportional to the concentration raised to the power of zero.

qEn: Which part of the human brain maintains posture and balance of the body?
qHi: मानव मस्तिष्क का कौन सा भाग शरीर की भंगिमा (मुद्रा) और संतुलन को बनाए रखता है?
explainEn: The cerebellum coordinates voluntary movements and maintains posture, equilibrium, and balance.

qEn: Which economic sector is primarily associated with the extraction of natural resources such as agriculture, mining, and fishing?
qHi: कौन सा आर्थिक क्षेत्र मुख्य रूप से कृषि, खनन और मछली पकड़ने जैसे प्राकृतिक संसाधनों के निष्कर्षण से जुड़ा है?
explainEn: The primary sector includes activities that involve the direct extraction and harvesting of natural resources from the earth.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Economics / Class 10 Social Science

qEn: What type of chemical linkage joins the individual monomers of a nucleic acid (DNA or RNA) together?
qHi: किस प्रकार का रासायनिक बंधन न्यूक्लिक अम्ल (DNA या RNA) के एकलकों (monomers) को आपस में जोड़ता है?
explainEn: Adjacent nucleotides in a nucleic acid strand are linked together by 3'-5' phosphodiester bonds.

qEn: Which greenhouse gas is produced naturally through the decomposition of organic matter by anaerobic bacteria in wetlands?
qHi: आर्द्रभूमि (वेटलैंड्स) में अवायवीय जीवाणुओं द्वारा कार्बनिक पदार्थों के अपघटन के माध्यम से कौन सी ग्रीनहाउस गैस प्राकृतिक रूप से उत्पन्न होती है?
explainEn: Methane is produced in anoxic environments like wetlands, paddy fields, and ruminant digestive systems by methanogenic bacteria.

qEn: Which of the following greenhouse gases is released during the cultivation of paddy fields?
qHi: धान के खेतों की खेती के दौरान निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी ग्रीनहाउस गैस निकलती है?
explainEn: Anaerobic conditions in flooded paddy fields produce methane gas through methanogenic bacteria.

qEn: What is the SI unit of electric potential?
qHi: विद्युत विभव का एसआई मात्रक क्या है?
explainEn: The SI unit of electric potential and potential difference is the volt, named after Alessandro Volta.

qEn: Which type of chemical bond is present in a sodium chloride molecule?
qHi: सोडियम क्लोराइड अणु में किस प्रकार का रासायनिक बंधन मौजूद होता है?
explainEn: Sodium chloride is formed by the complete transfer of electrons from sodium to chlorine, forming an ionic bond.

qEn: Who wrote the famous book 'Ain-i-Akbari'?
qHi: प्रसिद्ध पुस्तक 'आईन-ए-अकबरी' किसने लिखी थी?
explainEn: Ain-i-Akbari is the 16th-century detailed document recording the administration of Mughal Emperor Akbar by Abu'l-Fazl.

qEn: What does the term 'Laissez-faire' generally mean in economics?
qHi: अर्थशास्त्र में 'लेसे-फेयर' शब्द का सामान्यतः क्या अर्थ है?
optsEn: Minimum government intervention in economic affairs
Fixing maximum prices for all goods
optsHi: आर्थिक मामलों में न्यूनतम सरकारी हस्तक्षेप
सभी वस्तुओं के लिए अधिकतम मूल्य तय करना
explainEn: Laissez-faire is an economic philosophy advocating for free markets with minimum government interference.

qEn: In human genetics, what is the chromosomal representation of a normal human male?
qHi: मानव आनुवंशिकी में, एक सामान्य मानव पुरुष का गुणसूत्र प्रतिनिधित्व क्या है?
explainEn: Human males have 22 pairs of autosomes and one X and one Y sex chromosome, written as 44 + XY.

qEn: Which organization regulates the issuance and trading of securities in the Indian capital markets?
qHi: भारतीय पूंजी बाजारों में प्रतिभूतियों के निर्गम और व्यापार को कौन सा संगठन विनियमित करता है?
explainEn: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) is the regulator for the securities market in India.

qEn: Which organelle is primarily responsible for the packaging and dispatch of materials synthesized in the endoplasmic reticulum?
qHi: कौन सा अंगक मुख्य रूप से एंडोप्लाज्मिक रेटिकुलम में संश्लेषित पदार्थों के पैकेजिंग और प्रेषण के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: The Golgi apparatus modifies, packages, and transports proteins and lipids received from the endoplasmic reticulum.

qEn: Which Article of the Indian Constitution provides the right to constitutional remedies?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद संवैधानिक उपचार का अधिकार प्रदान करता है?
explainEn: Article 32 gives the right to move the Supreme Court for the enforcement of Fundamental Rights, famously called the heart and soul of the Constitution.

qEn: Which functional group is present in aldehydes?
qHi: एल्डिहाइड में कौन सा क्रियात्मक समूह मौजूद होता है?
explainEn: Aldehydes contain the formyl functional group, represented as -CHO.

qEn: In microeconomics, when total utility reaches its maximum, what is the value of marginal utility?
qHi: व्यष्टि अर्थशास्त्र में, जब कुल उपयोगिता अपने अधिकतम पर पहुँच जाती है, तब सीमांत उपयोगिता का मान क्या होता है?
explainEn: When total utility is at its maximum, marginal utility becomes zero according to the law of diminishing marginal utility.

qEn: Which of the following sites of the Indus Valley Civilization is known for its dockyard?
qHi: सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता का निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा स्थल अपने गोदीबाड़ा (डॉकयार्ड) के लिए जाना जाता है?
explainEn: Lothal in Gujarat features a massive brick basin identified as a dockyard, indicating maritime trade.

qEn: What type of reproduction involves the development of an unfertilized egg into a new individual?
qHi: किस प्रकार के जनन में एक अनिषेचित अंडा नए जीव में विकसित होता है?
explainEn: Parthenogenesis is a form of asexual reproduction where an embryo develops from an unfertilized egg cell, seen in some lizards and insects.

qEn: Which of the following is a fundamental right guaranteed by the Constitution of India?
qHi: भारत के संविधान द्वारा गारंटीकृत मौलिक अधिकार निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा है?
optsEn: Right to property as a fundamental right
Right to vote in national elections
optsHi: मौलिक अधिकार के रूप में संपत्ति का अधिकार
राष्ट्रीय चुनावों में मतदान का अधिकार
explainEn: Right to equality is enshrined in Articles 14-18 of the Indian Constitution as a Fundamental Right.

qEn: What is the primary role of the Reserve Bank of India?
qHi: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक की प्राथमिक भूमिका क्या है?
optsEn: Issuing currency and regulating monetary policy
Conducting general elections in the country
Formulating the foreign policy of India
optsHi: मुद्रा जारी करना और मौद्रिक नीति को विनियमित करना
भारत की विदेश नीति तैयार करना
भारतीय रेलवे नेटवर्क का प्रबंधन करना
explainEn: The Reserve Bank of India is India's central bank, responsible for issuing currency notes and regulating the monetary policy.

qEn: Which chemical element has the chemical symbol Fe?
qHi: किस रासायनिक तत्व का रासायनिक प्रतीक Fe है?
explainEn: The chemical symbol Fe stands for iron, derived from its Latin name ferrum.

qEn: Who wrote the famous ancient Indian text 'Arthashastra'?
qHi: प्रसिद्ध प्राचीन भारतीय ग्रंथ 'अर्थशास्त्र' किसने लिखा था?
explainEn: Arthashastra was authored by Kautilya, also known as Chanakya.

qEn: What is the process by which plants make their own food using sunlight called?
qHi: पौधों द्वारा सूर्य के प्रकाश का उपयोग करके अपना भोजन बनाने की प्रक्रिया को क्या कहा जाता है?
explainEn: Photosynthesis is the process used by plants to convert light energy into chemical energy.

qEn: Which constitutional body in India conducts elections to the Lok Sabha and Vidhan Sabha?
qHi: भारत में कौन सा संवैधानिक निकाय लोकसभा और विधानसभा के चुनाव कराता है?
explainEn: The Election Commission of India is an autonomous constitutional authority responsible for administering election processes in India.

qEn: Which sector is primarily associated with the extraction of natural resources like agriculture and mining?
qHi: कृषि और खनन जैसे प्राकृतिक संसाधनों के निष्कर्षण से मुख्य रूप से कौन सा क्षेत्र जुड़ा है?
explainEn: The primary sector includes activities that are undertaken by directly using natural resources like agriculture, fishing, and mining.

qEn: What is the order of a chemical reaction if the rate of the reaction is independent of the concentration of the reactants?
qHi: रासायनिक अभिक्रिया की कोटि क्या होगी यदि अभिक्रिया की दर अभिकारकों की सांद्रता से स्वतंत्र है?
explainEn: For a zero-order reaction, the rate is proportional to the zero power of the concentration of reactants, meaning it remains constant regardless of concentration changes.

qEn: Which type of lens is commonly used to correct myopia (nearsightedness) in human eyes?
qHi: मानव नेत्रों में निकट दृष्टि दोष (मायोपिया) को ठीक करने के लिए सामान्यतः किस प्रकार के लेंस का उपयोग किया जाता है?
explainEn: A concave lens diverges incoming light rays before they enter the eye, allowing the image to form correctly on the retina in a myopic eye.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 10 Science, Chapter 11 (Human Eye and Colorful World)

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution guarantees the right to equality before the law?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद कानून के समक्ष समानता के अधिकार की गारंटी देता है?
explainEn: Article 14 of the Constitution of India states that the State shall not deny to any person equality before the law or the equal protection of the laws within the territory of India.
sourceHint: Constitution of India / NCERT Class 11 Political Science

qEn: What is the primary function of leghemoglobin found in root nodules of leguminous plants?
qHi: फलीदार पौधों की जड़ की गांठों में पाए जाने والے लेगहीमोग्लोबिन का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
explainEn: Leghemoglobin acts as an oxygen scavenger in root nodules, protecting the oxygen-sensitive enzyme nitrogenase so it can fix atmospheric nitrogen.

qEn: Which of the following mountain ranges separates Europe from Asia?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी पर्वत श्रृंखला यूरोप को एशिया से अलग करती है?
explainEn: The Ural Mountains run roughly north-to-south through Russia and are traditionally considered a natural geographic boundary between Europe and Asia.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography, Fundamentals of Physical Geography

qEn: What is the output generated by the Python expression type(5.0) ?
qHi: पायथन व्यंजक type(5.0) द्वारा उत्पन्न आउटपुट क्या है?
explainEn: In Python, numbers with a decimal point, such as 5.0, are treated as floating-point numbers, so the type() function returns <class 'float'>.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Computer Science, Chapter 3 (Python Fundamentals)

qEn: Which Fundamental Right guarantees the right to constitutional remedies?
qHi: कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार संवैधानिक उपचार का अधिकार प्रदान करता है?
explainEn: Article 32 of the Indian Constitution provides the right to constitutional remedies, allowing individuals to move the Supreme Court for enforcement of rights.
sourceHint: Constitution of India, NCERT Class 12 Political Science

qEn: Which of the following is a transition metal?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी एक संक्रमण धातु है?
explainEn: Iron (Fe) is a d-block element, which are commonly referred to as transition metals.

qEn: Who wrote the historical travelogue 'Kitab-ul-Hind'?
qHi: ऐतिहासिक यात्रा वृत्तांत 'किताब-उल-हिंद' किसने लिखा था?
explainEn: Al-Biruni wrote 'Kitab-ul-Hind' in Arabic, providing deep insights into Indian science, religion, and social life during the 11th century.

qEn: In microeconomics, what does a downward-sloping demand curve generally indicate?
qHi: व्यष्टि अर्थशास्त्र में, नीचे की ओर ढलान वाला मांग वक्र आमतौर पर क्या दर्शाता है?
optsEn: Inverse relationship between price and quantity demanded
Direct relationship between price and quantity demanded
No relationship between price and quantity
optsHi: कीमत और मांग की गई मात्रा के बीच विपरीत संबंध
कीमत और मांग की गई मात्रा के बीच सीधा संबंध
कीमत और मात्रा के बीच कोई संबंध नहीं
explainEn: According to the law of demand, as the price of a good falls, the demand for it generally rises, showing an inverse relationship.

qEn: What is the primary function of ribosomes in a cell?
qHi: कोशिका में राइबोसोम का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
explainEn: Ribosomes are biological macromoelcules responsible for synthesizing proteins by translating messenger RNA.

qEn: What is the order of the reaction if the rate of the reaction is independent of the concentration of the reactants?
qHi: यदि अभिक्रिया का वेग अभिकारकों की सांद्रता पर निर्भर न हो, तो अभिक्रिया की कोटि क्या होगी?
explainEn: A zero-order reaction is one whose rate is independent of the concentration of the reactants.

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution provides for the establishment of a Supreme Court of India?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद भारत के उच्चतम न्यायालय की स्थापना का प्रावधान करता है?
explainEn: Article 124 of the Constitution of India provides for the establishment and constitution of the Supreme Court.

qEn: Who among the following wrote the book 'Ain-i-Akbari'?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से किसने 'आइन-ए-अकबरी' पुस्तक लिखी है?
explainEn: Ain-i-Akbari is the 16th-century detailed document recording the administration of the Mughal Empire by Emperor Akbar, written by his vizier, Abu'l-Fazl.

qEn: Which macroeconomic policy instrument involves the central bank buying and selling government securities in the open market?
qHi: किस समष्टि आर्थिक नीति उपकरण में केंद्रीय बैंक खुले बाजार में सरकारी प्रतिभूतियों को खरीदना और बेचना शामिल करता है?
explainEn: Open market operations refer to the buying and selling of government securities by the central bank to control the money supply.

qEn: Which type of cloud is typically associated with heavy rainfall, thunder, and lightning?
qHi: किस प्रकार का बादल आमतौर पर भारी वर्षा, गर्जन और बिजली से जुड़ा होता है?
explainEn: Cumulonimbus clouds are dense, towering vertical clouds associated with thunderstorms and atmospheric instability.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography, Fundamentals of Physical Geography

qEn: In Python programming, which data type is mutable among the following?
qHi: पायथन प्रोग्रामिंग में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा डेटा प्रकार परिवर्तनीय (म्यूटेबल) है?
explainEn: Lists in Python are mutable, meaning their elements can be modified after creation, unlike tuples and strings.

qEn: Who wrote the famous medieval Indian text 'Ain-i-Akbari'?
qHi: प्रसिद्ध मध्यकालीन भारतीय ग्रंथ 'आईना-ए-अकबरी' किसने लिखा था?
explainEn: Ain-i-Akbari is the third volume of the Akbarnama, written by Akbar's court historian Abul Fazl.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History, Kings and Chronicles

qEn: What type of market structure has a single seller and no close substitutes?
qHi: किस बाजार संरचना में एक अकेला विक्रेता और कोई निकट विकल्प नहीं होता है?
explainEn: A monopoly is characterized by a market with a single seller selling a unique product with no close substitutes.

qEn: In Python programming, which data type is mutable?
qHi: पायथन प्रोग्रामिंग में, कौन सा डेटा प्रकार परिवर्तनीय (mutable) है?
explainEn: In Python, lists are mutable data types, meaning their elements can be modified after creation, unlike tuples, strings, and integers.

qEn: Which Article of the Constitution of India abolishes 'Untouchability' and forbids its practice in any form?
qHi: भारत के संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'अस्पृश्यता' को समाप्त करता है और किसी भी रूप में इसके अभ्यास पर प्रतिबंध लगाता है?
explainEn: Article 17 of the Indian Constitution abolishes untouchability and makes its practice in any form a punishable offense.

qEn: In a p-type semiconductor, which of the following acts as the majority charge carriers?
qHi: एक p-प्रकार के अर्धचालक में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन बहुमत आवेश वाहक के रूप में कार्य करता है?
explainEn: Doping an intrinsic semiconductor with trivalent impurities creates electron vacancies known as holes, which are the majority charge carriers in p-type semiconductors.

qEn: Which macroeconomic policy instrument involves the central bank buying or selling government securities in the open market?
qHi: किस समष्टि आर्थिक नीति उपकरण में केंद्रीय बैंक खुले बाजार में सरकारी प्रतिभूतियों को खरीदना या बेचना शामिल करता है?
explainEn: Open market operations refer to the buying and selling of government securities by the central bank to control the money supply.

qEn: What is the coordination number of the central metal ion in a face-centered cubic close-packed metal crystal structure?
qHi: फलक-केंद्रित घनीय संकुलित धातु क्रिस्टल संरचना में केंद्रीय धातु आयन की उपसहसंयोजन संख्या क्या है?
explainEn: In both face-centered cubic (FCC) and hexagonal close-packed (HCP) arrangements, each sphere is in contact with 12 adjacent spheres, giving a coordination number of 12.

qEn: Which British official introduced the policy of Doctrine of Lapse to expand British dominion in India?
qHi: भारत में ब्रिटिश आधिपत्य का विस्तार करने के लिए किस ब्रिटिश अधिकारी ने हड़प नीति (Doctrine of Lapse) की शुरुआत की थी?
explainEn: Lord Dalhousie, Governor-General of India, extensively applied the Doctrine of Lapse to annex various princely states.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History, Themes in Indian History Part III

qEn: In English literature, what is the term for a metrical line consisting of five metrical feet, typically used in blank verse and sonnets?
qHi: अंग्रेजी साहित्य में, पांच छंद पाद से मिलकर बनी पद्य पंक्ति को क्या कहा जाता है, जिसका उपयोग आमतौर पर ब्लैंक वर्स और सोनेट में किया जाता है?
explainEn: Iambic pentameter consists of a line with five iambic feet, forming the standard rhythm of English poetry such as Shakespearean sonnets.

qEn: In linear programming problems, what is the term used for the inequalities or equations that limit the values of decision variables?
qHi: रैखिक प्रोग्रामिंग समस्याओं में, उन असमानताओं या समीकरणों के लिए किस शब्द का उपयोग किया जाता है जो निर्णय चर के मानों को सीमित करते हैं?
explainEn: Constraints are the linear inequalities or equations that set restrictions on the decision variables in a linear programming problem.

qEn: Which of the following sites of the Harappan civilization yielded a dockyard?
qHi: हड़प्पा सभ्यता के निम्नलिखित में से किस स्थल से एक गोदीबाड़ा (डॉकयार्ड) प्राप्त हुआ था?
explainEn: Lothal in Gujarat is well-known for its brick dockyard connected to the Gulf of Khambhat, indicating maritime trade in the Harappan civilization.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History - Bricks, Beads and Bones

qEn: In the context of the Mughal Empire, what was the primary function of a 'Amin'?
qHi: मुगल साम्राज्य के संदर्भ में, 'अमीन' का मुख्य कार्य क्या था?
explainEn: The Amin was an official responsible for inspecting and assessing land revenue in the Mughal administrative system.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History - Peasants, Zamindars and the State

qEn: Which institutional body in India prepares the National Accounts Statistics, covering GDP estimates?
qHi: भारत में सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) के अनुमानों को शामिल करते हुए राष्ट्रीय लेखा सांख्यिकी कौन सा संस्थागत निकाय तैयार करता है?
explainEn: The National Statistical Office (NSO), under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, is responsible for macroeconomic data collection and GDP estimation.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Economics - National Income Accounting

qEn: In a p-n junction diode, what happens to the depletion region under forward bias?
qHi: एक p-n जंक्शन डायोड में, अग्र अभिनति (फॉरवर्ड बाइस) के तहत अवक्षय क्षेत्र (डिप्लेशन रीजन) का क्या होता है?
optsEn: It disappears completely at zero volts
optsHi: यह शून्य वोल्ट पर पूरी तरह से गायब हो जाता है
explainEn: Under forward bias, the applied voltage opposes the potential barrier, which reduces the width of the depletion region.

qEn: Which coordination compound exhibits linkage isomerism due to an ambidentate ligand?
qHi: कौन सा उपसहसंयोजन यौगिक एक उभयदन्तुक (एम्बिडेंटेट) लिगैंड के कारण लिंकेज आइसोमेरिज्म (बंधन समावयवता) प्रदर्शित करता है?
explainEn: The nitrite ion (NO2-) is an ambidentate ligand that can coordinate through nitrogen or oxygen, leading to linkage isomerism in [Co(NH3)5(NO2)]Cl2.

qEn: Which specialized tissue in flowering plants is primarily responsible for the transport of water and minerals?
qHi: फूल वाले पौधों में कौन सा विशिष्ट ऊतक मुख्य रूप से पानी और खनिजों के परिवहन के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: Xylem is the vascular tissue in plants that transports water and dissolved minerals upward from the roots.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Biology - Anatomy of Flowering Plants

qEn: In Macroeconomics, what does the term 'Marginal Propensity to Consume' (MPC) measure?
qHi: समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र (मैक्रोइकॉनॉमिक्स) में, 'उपभोग की सीमांत प्रवृत्ति' (MPC) पद क्या मापता है?
optsEn: Total consumption divided by total income
Change in consumption resulting from a change in income
Total savings divided by total investment
Change in investment resulting from a change in interest rate
optsHi: कुल उपभोग को कुल आय से विभाजित करना
आय में परिवर्तन के परिणामस्वरूप उपभोग में परिवर्तन
कुल बचत को कुल निवेश से विभाजित करना
ब्याज दर में परिवर्तन के परिणामस्वरूप निवेश में परिवर्तन
explainEn: MPC is defined as the ratio of the change in consumption to the change in total income (ΔC / ΔY).
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Economics - Determination of Income and Employment

qEn: Which of the following is a primary sector economic activity?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी प्राथमिक क्षेत्र की आर्थिक गतिविधि है?
explainEn: Agriculture involves the extraction and harvesting of natural products, which defines the primary sector.

qEn: What is the full form of ASEAN?
qHi: ASEAN का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
optsEn: Alliance of South East African Nations
Association of Southern Economy and Navigation
optsHi: Alliance of South East African Nations
Association of Southern Economy and Navigation
explainEn: ASEAN stands for the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, a regional intergovernmental organization.

qEn: In macroeconomics, Gross Domestic Product (GDP) measures the total value of final goods and services produced within a country during a period of:
qHi: समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र में, सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) एक देश के भीतर एक निश्चित अवधि के दौरान उत्पादित अंतिम वस्तुओं और सेवाओं के कुल मूल्य को मापता है:
explainEn: GDP is standardly calculated over an annual accounting period or financial year.

qEn: Which part of a flowering plant develops into a seed after fertilization?
qHi: फूल वाले पौधे का कौन सा भाग निषेचन के बाद बीज में विकसित होता है?
explainEn: After fertilization, the ovule develops into a seed, while the ovary develops into the fruit.

qEn: Which organelle is considered the primary site for the synthesis of lipids in a eukaryotic cell?
qHi: यूकैरियोटिक कोशिका में लिपिड के संश्लेषण का प्राथमिक स्थल किस अंगक को माना जाता है?
explainEn: Smooth Endoplasmic Reticulum (SER) is devoid of ribosomes and is the major site for lipid synthesis in eukaryotic cells.

qEn: Which of the following elements shows a maximum oxidation state of +7 in its compounds?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा तत्व अपने यौगिकों में अधिकतम +7 ऑक्सीकरण अवस्था प्रदर्शित करता है?
explainEn: Manganese, a 3d transition metal, exhibits a maximum oxidation state of +7, as seen in potassium permanganate (KMnO4).

qEn: In which type of economic system are the factors of production owned, controlled, and operated by the government?
qHi: किस प्रकार की आर्थिक प्रणाली में उत्पादन के कारकों का स्वामित्व, नियंत्रण और संचालन सरकार द्वारा किया जाता है?
explainEn: In a centrally planned economy, all important decisions regarding production and distribution are made by the government.

qEn: Which term describes the total volume of air a person can exhale after a maximum inspiration?
qHi: उस शब्द का चयन करें जो अधिकतम अंतःश्वसन के बाद एक व्यक्ति द्वारा बाहर निकाली जा सकने वाली कुल वायु के आयतन को दर्शाता है।
explainEn: Vital capacity is the maximum volume of air a person can breathe in after a forced expiration or exhale after a forced inspiration.

qEn: Who among the following was the court historian of Mughal Emperor Akbar and author of the Akbarnama?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन मुगल सम्राट अकबर के दरबारी इतिहासकार और अकबरनामा के लेखक थे?
explainEn: Abul Fazl was Akbar's chief minister and court historian, best known for writing the Akbarnama.

qEn: Which constitutional amendment added the Fundamental Duties to the Indian Constitution based on the recommendation of the Swaran Singh Committee?
qHi: किस संविधान संशोधन ने स्वर्ण सिंह समिति की सिफारिश के आधार पर भारतीय संविधान में मौलिक कर्तव्यों को जोड़ा था?
explainEn: The 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1976 added Part IV-A and Article 51A to the Constitution, incorporating ten Fundamental Duties.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Indian Constitution at Work, Chapter on Rights

qEn: In macroeconomics, which of the following represents the slope of the Saving Function with respect to income?
qHi: समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन आय के संबंध में बचत फलन के ढलान को दर्शाता है?
explainEn: The Marginal Propensity to Save (MPS) is the ratio of change in saving to the change in total income, representing the slope of the saving function.

qEn: Which enzyme is responsible for the continuous replication of the leading strand during DNA replication?
qHi: डीएनए प्रतिकृति के दौरान अग्रणी स्ट्रैंड की निरंतर प्रतिकृति के लिए कौन सा एंजाइम जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: DNA polymerase adds nucleotides continuously in the 5' to 3' direction along the leading strand during DNA replication.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Biology, Chapter 6: Molecular Basis of Inheritance

qEn: Which specific treaty concluded the Thirty Years' War in Europe in 1648 and established the principle of state sovereignty?
qHi: यूरोप में 1648 में किस विशिष्ट संधि ने तीस वर्षीय युद्ध को समाप्त किया और राज्य की संप्रभुता के सिद्धांत को स्थापित किया?
explainEn: The Peace of Westphalia in 1648 ended the Thirty Years' War and is widely recognized in political theory as the foundation of the modern state system.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Political Science, Contemporary World Politics

qEn: During the colonial period in India, the Ryotwari System of land revenue settlement was primarily introduced in which region?
qHi: भारत में औपनिवेशिक काल के दौरान, भू-राजस्व बंदोबस्त की रयतवाड़ी व्यवस्था मुख्य रूप से किस क्षेत्र में शुरू की गई थी?
explainEn: The Ryotwari system was introduced primarily in the Madras and Bombay presidencies by Thomas Munro and Captain Read.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History, Themes in Indian History Part III, Chapter 10

qEn: In coordination chemistry according to IUPAC nomenclature, what is the correct oxidation state of iron in [Fe(CN)6]3-?
qHi: आईयूपीएसी नामकरण के अनुसार समन्वय रसायन विज्ञान में, [Fe(CN)6]3- में लोहे की सही ऑक्सीकरण अवस्था क्या है?
explainEn: Cyanide (CN-) has a charge of -1. With six cyanide ligands and an overall charge of -3, iron must be in the +3 oxidation state (x + 6(-1) = -3, so x = +3).
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Chemistry Part I, Chapter 5: Coordination Compounds

qEn: Which type of crystalline solid is silicon dioxide (quartz) classified under?
qHi: सिलिकॉन डाइऑक्साइड (क्वार्ट्ज) को किस प्रकार के क्रिस्टलीय ठोस के अंतर्गत वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
explainEn: Silicon dioxide forms a giant three-dimensional network structure where silicon and oxygen atoms are bonded via covalent bonds, making it a network solid.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Chemistry Part I, Chapter 1: The Solid State

qEn: Which fundamental right under the Indian Constitution guarantees the protection of life and personal liberty?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान के तहत कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार जीवन और व्यक्तिगत स्वतंत्रता की सुरक्षा की गारंटी देता है?
explainEn: Article 21 states that no person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Indian Constitution at Work, Chapter on Rights

qEn: Which organelle is known as the powerhouse of the cell in plant and animal cells?
qHi: किस कोशिकांग को पादप और जंतु कोशिकाओं का पावरहाउस कहा जाता है?
explainEn: Mitochondria generate most of the chemical energy needed to power the biochemical reactions of the cell.

qEn: Which of the following is a transition element in the periodic table?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन आवर्त सारणी में एक संक्रमण तत्व है?
explainEn: Iron belongs to the d-block elements, which are known as transition elements.

qEn: What is the name of the central banking institution of India?
qHi: भारत के केंद्रीय बैंकिंग संस्थान का क्या नाम है?
explainEn: The Reserve Bank of India is India's central bank and regulatory body.

qEn: Who wrote the famous ancient Indian treatise on statecraft titled Arthashastra?
qHi: राज्यकला पर प्रसिद्ध प्राचीन भारतीय ग्रंथ अर्थशास्त्र किसने लिखा था?
explainEn: Arthashastra was authored by Kautilya, also known as Chanakya.

qEn: What is the primary function of ribosomes in a living cell?
qHi: एक जीवित कोशिका में राइबोसोम का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
explainEn: Ribosomes are biological macromoelcules responsible for cellular protein synthesis.

qEn: Which catalyst is used in the industrial preparation of ammonia by Haber's process?
qHi: हैबर विधि द्वारा अमोनिया के औद्योगिक निर्माण में किस उत्प्रेरक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
optsEn: Finely divided iron with molybdenum as promoter
optsHi: मोलिब्डेनम प्रमोटर के साथ बारीक विभाजित लोहा
explainEn: In Haber's process for ammonia synthesis, iron is used as a catalyst and molybdenum acts as a promoter.

qEn: Who wrote the famous book 'The Wealth of Nations' in 1776, laying the foundations of classical economics?
qHi: शास्त्रीय अर्थशास्त्र की नींव रखते हुए 1776 में प्रसिद्ध पुस्तक 'द वेल्थ ऑफ नेशंस' किसने लिखी?
explainEn: Adam Smith published 'An Inquiry into the Nature and Causes of the Wealth of Nations' in 1776.

qEn: In which sedimentary basin of India was oil first discovered on a commercial scale in the nineteenth century?
qHi: उन्नीसवीं शताब्दी में भारत के किस तलछटी बेसिन में व्यावसायिक पैमाने पर पहली बार तेल की खोज की गई थी?
explainEn: Oil was first discovered commercially in Assam, specifically at Digboi, in the late nineteenth century.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Geography, India People and Economy

qEn: Which Harappan site is well known for its unique water management system involving a series of reservoirs?
qHi: कौन सा हड़प्पा स्थल जलाशयों की एक श्रृंखला से जुड़ी अपनी अनूठी जल प्रबंधन प्रणाली के लिए अच्छी तरह जाना जाता है?
explainEn: Dholavira in Gujarat features sophisticated water management systems, including large stone-cut reservoirs.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History, Themes in Indian History Part I

qEn: What is the process of conversion of raw data into understandable information called in a database context?
qHi: डेटाबेस के संदर्भ में कच्चे डेटा को समझने योग्य जानकारी में बदलने की प्रक्रिया को क्या कहा जाता है?
explainEn: Data processing is the conversion of raw data into meaningful and structured information.

qEn: In which year was the Planning Commission of India established?
qHi: भारत के योजना आयोग की स्थापना किस वर्ष की गई थी?
explainEn: The Planning Commission was set up in March 1950 by a resolution of the Government of India.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Politics in India Since Independence

qEn: What does 'Malthusian trap' relate to in economics and demography?
qHi: अर्थशास्त्र और जनसांख्यिकी में 'माल्थसियन ट्रैप' किससे संबंधित है?
optsHi: जनसंख्या वृद्धि का खाद्य आपूर्ति से आगे निकल जाना
मुद्रास्फीति का ब्याज दरों से अधिक होना
आयात का निर्यात से अधिक होना
explainEn: Thomas Malthus argued that population grows geometrically while food production grows arithmetically, leading to a trap.

qEn: Which chemical compound is primarily responsible for the ozone layer depletion in the stratosphere?
qHi: समताप मंडल में ओजोन परत के क्षरण के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सा रासायनिक यौगिक जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) release chlorine atoms upon UV exposure, which catalytically destroy ozone molecules.

qEn: Who among the following was the first President of independent India?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन स्वतंत्र भारत के पहले राष्ट्रपति थे?
explainEn: Dr. Rajendra Prasad served as the first President of India from 1950 to 1962.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Politics in India Since Independence

qEn: Which sector is known as the primary sector in economic activities?
qHi: आर्थिक गतिविधियों में किस क्षेत्र को प्राथमिक क्षेत्र के रूप में जाना जाता है?
explainEn: Agriculture, forestry, fishing, and mining constitute the primary sector as they involve extracting natural resources.

qEn: Which organelle is primarily responsible for the packaging and dispatch of materials synthesized in the cell?
qHi: कौन सा कोशिकांग मुख्य रूप से कोशिका में संश्लेषित पदार्थों के पैकेजिंग और प्रेषण के लिए उत्तरदायी है?
explainEn: The Golgi apparatus modifies, packages, and transports proteins and lipids received from the endoplasmic reticulum.

qEn: What type of chemical bond links the monomers of a DNA strand together along its backbone?
qHi: DNA रज्जु के मेरुदंड (backbone) के साथ इसके एकलकों (monomers) को कौन सा रासायनिक बंधन जोड़ता है?
explainEn: Phosphodiester bonds link the 3' carbon of one sugar molecule to the 5' carbon of another in the DNA sugar-phosphate backbone.

qEn: Which fundamental right in the Indian Constitution guarantees the protection of life and personal liberty?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान में कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार जीवन और व्यक्तिगत स्वतंत्रता की सुरक्षा की गारंटी देता है?
explainEn: Article 21 states that no person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.

qEn: In macroeconomics, which of the following is considered a stock variable rather than a flow variable?
qHi: समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र में, निम्नलिखित में से किसे प्रवाह चर के बजाय एक स्टॉक चर माना जाता है?
explainEn: Capital is measured at a specific point in time, making it a stock variable, whereas income, consumption, and investment are measured over a period.

qEn: Which chemical element is responsible for the dark reaction (Calvin cycle) of photosynthesis to initially fix carbon dioxide?
qHi: प्रकाश संश्लेषण की अदीप्त अभिक्रिया (कैल्विन चक्र) में कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड को प्रारंभिक रूप से स्थिर करने के लिए कौन सा रासायनिक तत्व उत्तरदायी है?
explainEn: Carbon dioxide fixation during the Calvin cycle incorporates inorganic carbon into organic molecules.

qEn: Which British official introduced the Doctrine of Lapse to annex various princely states in India?
qHi: किस ब्रिटिश अधिकारी ने भारत में विभिन्न रियासतों का विलय करने के लिए 'व्यपगत का सिद्धांत' (डक्ट्रिन ऑफ लैप्स) शुरू किया था?
explainEn: Lord Dalhousie applied the Doctrine of Lapse aggressively during his tenure as Governor-General from 1848 to 1856.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History, Themes in Indian History Part III

qEn: What is the SI unit of electric capacitance?
qHi: विद्युत धारिता का एसआई (SI) मात्रक क्या है?
explainEn: The farad (symbol: F) is the SI derived unit of electrical capacitance.

qEn: In which type of chemical reaction does the oxidation state of elements change simultaneously?
qHi: किस प्रकार की रासायनिक अभिक्रिया में तत्वों की ऑक्सीकरण अवस्था एक साथ बदलती है?
explainEn: In a redox (reduction-oxidation) reaction, one species is oxidized while another is reduced, changing their oxidation states.

qEn: Which of the following components forms the central core of the Earth?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा घटक पृथ्वी के केंद्रीय क्रोड का निर्माण करता है?
explainEn: The core of the Earth is primarily composed of heavy metals, specifically Nickel (Ni) and Iron (Fe), often referred to as Nife.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography - Interior of the Earth

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution provides for the establishment of the Supreme Court of India?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद भारत के उच्चतम न्यायालय की स्थापना का प्रावधान करता है?
explainEn: Article 124 of the Constitution of India deals with the establishment and constitution of the Supreme Court.

qEn: What is the process of conversion of water vapor directly into ice called?
qHi: जल वाष्प का सीधे बर्फ में परिवर्तन की प्रक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
explainEn: Deposition is the thermodynamic process where a gas transforms directly into solid without passing through the liquid phase.

qEn: Who among the following was the permanent chairman of the Constituent Assembly of India?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन भारत की संविधान सभा के स्थायी अध्यक्ष थे?
explainEn: Dr. Rajendra Prasad was elected as the permanent chairman of the Constituent Assembly on December 11, 1946.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Political Science - Politics in India Since Independence

qEn: In economics, which sector does forestry and logging belong to?
qHi: अर्थशास्त्र में, वानिकी और कटाई किस क्षेत्र के अंतर्गत आते हैं?
explainEn: Primary sector activities include agriculture, forestry, animal husbandry, fishing, and mining, which are directly dependent on natural resources.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Economics - Introductory Micro and Macro Economics concepts

qEn: What is the unit of electric charge in the International System of Units (SI)?
qHi: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय इकाई प्रणाली (SI) में विद्युत आवेश की इकाई क्या है?
explainEn: The SI derived unit of electric charge is the coulomb, represented by the symbol C.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Physics - Electric Charges and Fields

qEn: Which Mughal emperor's reign is known as the golden age of Mughal architecture?
qHi: किस मुगल सम्राट के शासनकाल को मुगल स्थापत्य कला का स्वर्ण युग कहा जाता है?
explainEn: Shah Jahan's reign saw extensive construction using white marble, notably the Taj Mahal, marking the peak of Mughal architecture.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History - Themes in Indian History Part II

qEn: Which type of plant tissue is responsible for the transport of water and minerals in vascular plants?
qHi: संवहनी पौधों में जल और खनिजों के परिवहन के लिए किस प्रकार का पादप ऊतक उत्तरदायी है?
explainEn: Xylem is the specialized tissue in vascular plants that transports water and nutrients upward from the roots.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Biology - Anatomy of Flowering Plants

qEn: In a chemical reaction, the rate of reaction generally decreases with time because of which of the following factors?
qHi: एक रासायनिक अभिक्रिया में, समय के साथ अभिक्रिया की दर आमतौर पर किस कारक के कारण घट जाती है?
explainEn: As the reaction proceeds, reactants are consumed, leading to a decrease in their concentration which directly lowers the rate of reaction.

qEn: Which sector currently contributes the largest share to India's Gross Domestic Product (GDP)?
qHi: वर्तमान में कौन सा क्षेत्र भारत के सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) में सबसे बड़ा हिस्सा योगदान करता है?
explainEn: The tertiary sector (service sector) constitutes the largest share of India's GDP, surpassing agriculture and manufacturing.

qEn: Which type of plant hormone is primarily responsible for cell elongation and phototropism in stems?
qHi: तनों में कोशिका दीर्घीकरण और प्रकाशानुवर्तन (phototropism) के लिए मुख्य रूप से किस प्रकार का पादप हार्मोन जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: Auxins, such as IAA, promote cell elongation and are heavily involved in phototropic and gravitropic responses in plants.

qEn: Which of the following elements is a transition metal belonging to the 3d series?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा तत्व 3d श्रेणी से संबंधित एक संक्रमण धातु है?
explainEn: Scandium (atomic number 21) is the first element in the 3d transition series.

qEn: In English literary history, the Romantic period is generally considered to have begun with the publication of which work?
qHi: अंग्रेजी साहित्य के इतिहास में, रोमांटिक काल की शुरुआत आमतौर पर किस कृति के प्रकाशन से मानी जाती है?
explainEn: The publication of 'Lyrical Ballads' by William Wordsworth and Samuel Taylor Coleridge in 1798 marks the beginning of the Romantic literary movement in England.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 English Core / Literature history

qEn: In the context of the Indian Constitution, which fundamental right cannot be suspended even during a National Emergency declared under Article 352?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान के संदर्भ में, अनुच्छेद 352 के तहत घोषित राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल के दौरान भी कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार निलंबित नहीं किया जा सकता है?
explainEn: By the 44th Amendment Act, 1978, the right to protection in respect of conviction for offenses (Article 20) and the right to life and personal liberty (Article 21) cannot be suspended during a National Emergency.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Indian Constitution at Work, Chapter on Rights

qEn: Which enzyme is primarily responsible for the initial fixation of carbon dioxide in C4 plants during the Calvin-Benson cycle pathway?
qHi: 캘빈-벤슨 순환 경로 동안 C4 पौधों में कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड के प्रारंभिक स्थिरीकरण के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सा एंजाइम जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: In C4 plants, the first stable product is a 4-carbon compound (oxaloacetic acid), and the primary fixation of CO2 in mesophyll cells is catalysed by Phosphoenol pyruvate (PEP) carboxylase.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Biology, Chapter 13: Photosynthesis in Higher Plants

qEn: During the British colonial period in India, what was the primary objective of the 'Whitley Commission' appointed in 1929?
qHi: भारत में ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक काल के दौरान, 1929 में नियुक्त 'व्हitley आयोग' का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या था?
optsEn: To review the working conditions in Indian industries
To examine the financial relationship between the Centre and Provinces
To reform the higher education system in British India
To investigate the causes of agricultural indebtedness
optsHi: भारतीय उद्योगों में काम करने की स्थिति की समीक्षा करना
केंद्र और प्रांतों के बीच वित्तीय संबंध की जाँच करना
ब्रिटिश भारत में उच्च शिक्षा प्रणाली में सुधार करना
कृषि ऋणग्रस्तता के कारणों की जाँच करना
explainEn: The Royal Commission on Labour in India (known as the Whitley Commission) was appointed in 1929 to inquire into the existing conditions of labour in industrial undertakings and plantations in British India.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History, Themes in Indian History

qEn: In macroeconomics, what does an outward shift of the Production Possibility Frontier (PPF) typically indicate?
qHi: समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र में, उत्पादन संभावना सीमा (PPF) का बाहर की ओर खिसकना आमतौर पर क्या दर्शाता है?
optsEn: Economic growth and increase in total productive capacity
A shift in consumer preferences towards capital goods
A decrease in the general price level of goods and services
optsHi: आर्थिक विकास और कुल उत्पादक क्षमता में वृद्धि
पूंजीगत वस्तुओं की ओर उपभोक्ता प्राथमिकताओं में बदलाव
वस्तुओं और सेवाओं के सामान्य मूल्य स्तर में कमी
explainEn: An outward shift of the PPF represents economic growth, which can occur due to an increase in the total resource base or technological advancement.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Introductory Microeconomics and Macroeconomics

qEn: Which international treaty, adopted in 1987, is specifically aimed at phasing out substances that deplete the ozone layer?
qHi: 1987 में अपनाया गया कौन सा अंतर्राष्ट्रीय संधि विशेष रूप से ओजोन परत को क्षीण करने वाले पदार्थों को चरणबद्ध तरीके से समाप्त करने के उद्देश्य से है?
explainEn: The Montreal Protocol on Substances that Deplete the Ozone Layer is a landmark international agreement designed to protect the ozone layer by phasing out the production and consumption of ozone-depleting substances.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Biology, Chapter 16: Environmental Issues

qEn: Which of the following sites of the Indus Valley Civilization is known for its unique water management system involving a series of massive stone reservoirs?
qHi: सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता का निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा स्थल विशाल पत्थर के जलाशयों की एक श्रृंखला से जुड़ी अपनी अनूठी जल प्रबंधन प्रणाली के लिए जाना जाता है?
explainEn: Dholavira, located in Gujarat, is renowned for its sophisticated water management system, which included large water reservoirs, channels, and stepwells.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History, Themes in Indian History Part I

qEn: What is the primary role of restriction endonucleases in recombinant DNA technology?
qHi: पुनर्संयोजन डीएनए तकनीक में प्रतिबंध एंडोन्यूक्लीज की प्राथमिक भूमिका क्या है?
optsEn: To join two DNA fragments together
To cut DNA molecules at specific recognition sequences
To replicate DNA strands in a polymerase chain reaction
To transport foreign DNA into a host cell
optsHi: दो डीएनए खंडों को एक साथ जोड़ना
विशिष्ट पहचान अनुक्रमों पर डीएनए अणुओं को काटना
पॉलीमरेज़ चेन रिएक्शन में डीएनए स्ट्रैंड्स की प्रतिकृति बनाना
विदेशी डीएनए को एक मेज़बान कोशिका में परिवहन करना
explainEn: Restriction endonucleases function as 'molecular scissors' that inspect the DNA sequence and cut it at specific sites known as recognition sequences.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Biology, Chapter 11: Biotechnology - Principles and Processes

qEn: In the context of Indian classical music, which ancient text written by Bharata Muni is considered the foundational treatise on dramaturgy, music, and dance?
qHi: भारतीय शास्त्रीय संगीत के संदर्भ में, भरत मुनि द्वारा लिखित कौन सा प्राचीन ग्रंथ नाटक कला, संगीत और नृत्य पर मौलिक ग्रंथ माना जाता है?
explainEn: The Natya Shastra, attributed to the sage Bharata Muni, is the ancient Sanskrit treatise on performing arts, encompassing theatre, dance, and music.
sourceHint: NCERT Fine Arts Class 11/12, Introduction to Indian Art

qEn: Who wrote the famous book 'Arthashastra'?
qHi: प्रसिद्ध पुस्तक 'अर्थशास्त्र' किसने लिखी थी?
explainEn: Arthashastra was authored by Kautilya, also known as Chanakya.

qEn: Which gas is most abundant in the Earth's atmosphere by volume?
qHi: आयतन के हिसाब से पृथ्वी के वायुमंडल में कौन सी गैस सबसे प्रचुर मात्रा में है?
explainEn: Nitrogen makes up about 78 percent of Earth's atmosphere by volume.

qEn: What is the primary commercial crop grown in the state of Assam?
qHi: असम राज्य में उगाई जाने वाली मुख्य व्यावसायिक फसल कौन सी है?
explainEn: Assam is globally famous for its tea production, which is a major commercial crop of the region.

qEn: Which of the following is a scalar quantity?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी एक अदिश राशि है?
explainEn: Speed has magnitude only and no specific direction, making it a scalar quantity.

qEn: What is the order of a chemical reaction if its rate is independent of the concentration of the reactants?
qHi: यदि किसी रासायनिक अभिक्रिया की दर अभिकारकों की सांद्रता से स्वतंत्र है, तो उस अभिक्रिया की कोटि क्या होगी?
explainEn: A zero-order reaction has a rate that is independent of the reactant concentrations, meaning the rate equals the rate constant.

qEn: Which phenomenon provides direct experimental evidence for the wave nature of electrons?
qHi: कौन सी घटना इलेक्ट्रॉनों की तरंग प्रकृति के लिए प्रत्यक्ष प्रायोगिक प्रमाण प्रदान करती है?
explainEn: Davisson and Germer's experiment on electron diffraction demonstrated the wave nature of electrons, confirming de Broglie's hypothesis.

qEn: In macroeconomics, which measure includes the total value of goods and services produced within the domestic territory of a country along with net factor income from abroad?
qHi: समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र में, कौन सा माप किसी देश के घरेलू क्षेत्र के भीतर उत्पादित वस्तुओं और सेवाओं के कुल मूल्य के साथ-साथ विदेशों से शुद्ध कारक आय को शामिल करता है?
explainEn: Gross National Product (GNP) is defined as GDP plus net factor income from abroad.

qEn: Which type of crystalline solid is silicon carbide (SiC)?
qHi: सिलिकॉन कार्बाइड (SiC) किस प्रकार का क्रिस्टलीय ठोस है?
explainEn: Silicon carbide forms a giant three-dimensional covalent network structure similar to diamond, making it a covalent network solid.

qEn: What is the primary function of restriction endonucleases in recombinant DNA technology?
qHi: पुनर्योगज डीएनए तकनीक में रेस्ट्रिक्शन एंडोन्यूक्लीज का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
optsEn: To cut DNA at specific recognition sequences
To unwind the DNA double helix
optsHi: विशिष्ट पहचान अनुक्रमों पर डीएनए को काटना
explainEn: Restriction endonucleases act as molecular scissors, cutting DNA molecules at specific base sequences known as recognition sites.

qEn: Which greenhouse gas has the highest relative global warming potential over a 100-year timescale according to standard scientific assessments?
qHi: मानक वैज्ञानिक आकलन के अनुसार 100 वर्ष के समय-पैमाने पर किस ग्रीनहाउस गैस की सापेक्ष वैश्विक तापन क्षमता सबसे अधिक है?
explainEn: Sulfur hexafluoride (SF6) has an extremely high global warming potential, thousands of times greater than carbon dioxide over a 100-year period.

qEn: Which organelle is primarily responsible for the synthesis of membrane lipids in eukaryotic cells?
qHi: यूकेरियोटिक कोशिकाओं में झिल्ली लिपिड के संश्लेषण के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सा कोशिकांग जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: The smooth endoplasmic reticulum is the major site for synthesis of lipid molecules and steroid hormones in eukaryotic cells.

qEn: In a p-n junction diode under reverse bias, the current flowing through the circuit is primarily due to which of the following?
qHi: रिवर्स बायस के तहत एक p-n जंक्शन डायोड में, सर्किट से बहने वाली धारा मुख्य रूप से किसके कारण होती है?
optsEn: Thermal generation of majority charge carriers
optsHi: बहुसंख्यक आवेश वाहकों की तापीय उत्पत्ति
explainEn: Under reverse bias, minority carriers are swept across the junction by the electric field, producing a small reverse saturation current.

qEn: Which coordination compound exhibits linkage isomerism?
qHi: कौन सा उपसहसंयोजक यौगिक लिंकेज आइसोमेरिज्म (बंधक समावयवता) प्रदर्शित करता है?
explainEn: Linkage isomerism arises in coordination compounds containing ambidentate ligands such as NO2-.

qEn: Which Article of the Indian Constitution guarantees the right to constitutional remedies?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद संवैधानिक उपचार के अधिकार की गारंटी देता है?
explainEn: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar called Article 32 the heart and soul of the Indian Constitution as it provides the right to move the Supreme Court for enforcement of Fundamental Rights.

qEn: During the colonial period in India, the Ryotwari system of land revenue was primarily introduced in which region?
qHi: भारत में औपनिवेशिक काल के दौरान, भू-राजस्व की रयतवाड़ी व्यवस्था मुख्य रूप से किस क्षेत्र में शुरू की गई थी?
explainEn: The Ryotwari system was instituted primarily in the Madras and Bombay presidencies by Thomas Munro and Captain Read.

qEn: What is the primary objective of fiscal deficit in a government budget?
qHi: सरकारी बजट में राजकोषीय घाटे का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या दर्शाता है?
optsEn: Borrowing requirements of the government from all sources
optsHi: सभी स्रोतों से सरकार की उधार आवश्यकताएं
explainEn: Fiscal deficit gives the borrowing requirement of the government from all sources during a given financial year.

qEn: In human reproductive physiology, where does fertilization of the secondary oocyte typically occur?
qHi: मानव प्रजनन शरीर विज्ञान में, द्वितीयक ओसाइट का निषेचन आम तौर पर कहां होता है?
explainEn: Fertilization takes place when the sperm and ovum simultaneously reach the ampullary-isthmic junction of the fallopian tube.

qEn: Which metal is extracted primarily by the self-reduction process involving its sulfide ore?
qHi: किस धातु को मुख्य रूप से इसके सल्फाइड अयस्क से जुड़े स्व-अपचयन (self-reduction) प्रक्रिया द्वारा निकाला जाता है?
explainEn: Copper is extracted from copper glance (Cu2S) by self-reduction where a portion of the sulfide is roasted to oxide which then reacts with remaining sulfide.

qEn: In human genetics, what determines the biological sex of a child?
qHi: मानव आनुवंशिकी में, बच्चे के जैविक लिंग का निर्धारण कौन करता है?
optsEn: The sex chromosomes contributed by the father
The blood group of the mother
The nutrition of the mother during pregnancy
optsHi: पिता द्वारा दिए गए लिंग गुणसूत्र
गर्भावस्था के दौरान माँ का पोषण
explainEn: Human males produce X and Y sperm cells. If an X-bearing sperm fertilizes the egg, the child is female (XX); if a Y-bearing sperm does so, the child is male (XY).

qEn: Which Fundamental Right in the Indian Constitution prohibits discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex, or place of birth?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार धर्म, मूलवंश, जाति, लिंग या जन्म स्थान के आधार पर भेदभाव को प्रतिबंधित करता है?
explainEn: Article 15 of the Indian Constitution, under the Right to Equality, prohibits discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex, or place of birth.

qEn: What type of economic system is characterized by the coexistence of both private and public sectors?
qHi: किस प्रकार की आर्थिक प्रणाली की विशेषता निजी और सार्वजनिक दोनों क्षेत्रों का सह-अस्तित्व है?
explainEn: A mixed economy features a blend of private enterprise and state intervention.

qEn: Which part of the plant is primarily responsible for photosynthesis?
qHi: पौधे का कौन सा भाग मुख्य रूप से प्रकाश संश्लेषण के लिए उत्तरदायी है?
explainEn: Leaves contain chlorophyll and are the primary site of photosynthesis in plants.

qEn: Who was the chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Indian Constituent Assembly?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान सभा की प्रारूप समिति के अध्यक्ष कौन थे?
explainEn: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar chaired the Drafting Committee appointed to prepare a draft constitution for India.

qEn: What is the molecular geometry of a methane molecule (CH4) according to VSEPR theory?
qHi: VSEPR सिद्धांत के अनुसार मीथेन अणु (CH4) की आणविक ज्यामिति क्या है?
explainEn: Methane has four bonding pairs and zero lone pairs around the central carbon atom, resulting in a tetrahedral geometry with bond angles of 109.5 degrees.

qEn: In macroeconomics, which of the following is considered a flow variable?
qHi: समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र में, निम्नलिखित में से किसे प्रवाह चर माना जाता है?
explainEn: Investment is measured over a period of time, making it a flow variable, whereas capital and wealth are stock variables measured at a particular point in time.

qEn: Which type of crystalline solid is quartz (SiO2) classified under?
qHi: क्वेर्ट्ज़ (SiO2) को किस प्रकार के क्रिस्टलीय ठोस के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
explainEn: Quartz is a covalent network solid in which silicon and oxygen atoms are linked together by covalent bonds in a three-dimensional network.

qEn: Which process is primarily responsible for the transport of water up to great heights in tall trees?
qHi: लंबी पेड़ों में अत्यधिक ऊंचाई तक पानी के परिवहन के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सी प्रक्रिया जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: Transpiration pull creates a negative pressure potential in the xylem, pulling water up against gravity in tall plants.

qEn: Which soil type, formed due to intense leaching in tropical regions with high rainfall, is generally poor in organic matter?
qHi: उच्च वर्षा वाले उष्णकटिबंधीय क्षेत्रों में तीव्र निक्षालन के कारण बनने वाली कौन सी मिट्टी आम तौर पर कार्बनिक पदार्थों में कम होती है?
explainEn: Laterite soils develop in areas with high temperature and heavy rainfall, leading to heavy leaching which washes away nutrients, leaving soils low in organic matter.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Geography, India People and Economy

qEn: Which enzyme is primarily responsible for the continuous synthesis of the leading strand during DNA replication in Escherichia coli?
qHi: एशेशिया कोलाई में डीएनए प्रतिकृति के दौरान प्रमुख स्ट्रैंड के निरंतर संश्लेषण के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सा एंजाइम जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: DNA polymerase III is the main polymerizing enzyme responsible for de novo synthesis of both the leading and lagging strands in E. coli.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Biology, Chapter 6: Molecular Basis of Inheritance

qEn: What is the primary crystalline product formed during the commercial extraction of aluminium by the Hall-Héroult process before electrolytic reduction?
qHi: हॉल-हेरोल्ट प्रक्रिया द्वारा एल्यूमीनियम के व्यावसायिक निष्कर्षण के दौरान इलेक्ट्रोलाइटिक कमी से पहले बनने वाला मुख्य क्रिस्टलीय उत्पाद कौन सा है?
optsEn: Pure alumina dissolved in molten cryolite
optsHi: पिघले हुए क्रायोलाइट में घुला हुआ शुद्ध एलुमिना
explainEn: In the Hall-Héroult process, purified alumina (Al2O3) is dissolved in molten cryolite (Na3AlF6) to lower its melting point and increase conductivity before electrolysis.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Chemistry, Chapter 6: General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Elements

qEn: Which Article of the Constitution of India explicitly provides for the independence of the judiciary by stating that the State shall take steps to separate the judiciary from the executive in the public services of the State?
qHi: भारत के संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद राज्य की लोक सेवाओं में न्यायपालिका को कार्यपालिका से अलग करने के लिए राज्य द्वारा कदम उठाए जाने का प्रावधान करके स्पष्ट रूप से न्यायपालिका की स्वतंत्रता प्रदान करता है?
explainEn: Article 50 of the Directive Principles of State Policy in the Constitution of India directs the State to separate the judiciary from the executive.
sourceHint: Constitution of India, Part IV - Directive Principles of State Policy

qEn: In the context of macroeconomic equilibrium in a two-sector economy, if the marginal propensity to save (MPS) is 0.2, what is the value of the investment multiplier?
qHi: दो-क्षेत्रीय अर्थव्यवस्था में समष्टि आर्थिक संतुलन के संदर्भ में, यदि सीमांत बचत प्रवृत्ति (MPS) 0.2 है, तो निवेश गुणक का मान क्या है?
explainEn: The investment multiplier (k) is calculated as 1 / MPS. Since MPS is 0.2, k = 1 / 0.2 = 5.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Macroeconomics, Chapter 4: Determination of Income and Employment

qEn: Which British official introduced the 'Doctrine of Lapse', through which the princely states of Satara, Nagpur, and Jhansi were annexed?
qHi: किस ब्रिटिश अधिकारी ने 'व्यपगत का सिद्धांत' (डॉक्ट्रिन ऑफ लैप्स) शुरू किया था, जिसके माध्यम से सतारा, नागपुर और झाँसी की रियासतों का विलय किया गया था?
explainEn: Lord Dalhousie, who served as the Governor-General of India from 1848 to 1856, extensively applied the Doctrine of Lapse to annex various princely states.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History, Chapter 11: Rebels and the Raj

qEn: What is the primary chemical species responsible for the temporary hardness of water?
qHi: पानी की अस्थायी कठोरता के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सी रासायनिक प्रजाति जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: Temporary hardness in water is caused by the presence of dissolved bicarbonates of calcium and magnesium (Ca(HCO3)2 and Mg(HCO3)2).
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Chemistry, Chapter 9: Hydrogen (NCERT foundational for Class 12 inorganic chemistry)

qEn: In a p-n junction diode under reverse bias condition, what constitutes the primary flow of current across the junction?
qHi: पश्च अभिनति (रिवर्स बायस) स्थिति में पी-एन जंक्शन डायोड में जंक्शन के पार वर्तमान का प्राथमिक प्रवाह क्या बनाता है?
explainEn: Under reverse bias, the barrier height increases, impeding majority carriers. However, thermally generated minority charge carriers easily drift across the junction, constituting a small reverse saturation current.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Physics, Chapter 14: Semiconductor Electronics

qEn: Which fundamental right guaranteed by the Constitution of India cannot be suspended even during a National Emergency declared under Article 352?
qHi: भारत के संविधान द्वारा गारंटीकृत कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार अनुच्छेद 352 के तहत घोषित राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल के दौरान भी निलंबित नहीं किया जा सकता है?
explainEn: By the 44th Amendment Act, 1978, the rights guaranteed under Article 20 (protection in respect of conviction for offences) and Article 21 (protection of life and personal liberty) cannot be suspended during a National Emergency.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11/12 Political Science, Indian Constitution at Work / Polity basics

qEn: Who wrote the book 'Ain-i-Akbari'?
qHi: 'आईने अकबरी' पुस्तक किसने लिखी थी?
explainEn: Ain-i-Akbari was authored by Abul Fazl as the third volume of the Akbarnama, detailing the administration of Emperor Akbar.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History - Kings and Chronicles

qEn: What type of chemical reaction occurs when nitrogen and hydrogen combine to form ammonia in the Haber process?
qHi: हैबर प्रक्रिया में जब नाइट्रोजन और हाइड्रोजन मिलकर अमोनिया बनाते हैं, तो किस प्रकार की रासायनिक प्रतिक्रिया होती है?
explainEn: The combination of nitrogen and hydrogen to form ammonia is a synthesis or combination reaction.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Chemistry - The p-Block Elements

qEn: Which enzyme catalyzes the conversion of lactose into glucose and galactose?
qHi: कौन सा एंजाइम लैक्टोज को ग्लूकोज और गैलक्टोज में बदलने के लिए उत्प्रेरित करता है?
explainEn: Lactase is the specific enzyme that breaks down the disaccharide lactose into its monosaccharide components, glucose and galactose.

qEn: Which of the following is a macroeconomic variable?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र (मैक्रोइकॉनॉमिक्स) चर है?
explainEn: Macroeconomics studies the economy as a whole, and Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is a key macroeconomic aggregate.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Economics - Introduction to Macroeconomics

qEn: In a galvanic cell, oxidation always occurs at which of the following electrodes?
qHi: गैल्वेनिक सेल में, ऑक्सीकरण हमेशा किस इलेक्ट्रोड पर होता है?
explainEn: By definition, oxidation always takes place at the anode in both galvanic and electrolytic cells.

qEn: What type of interaction is exhibited by mycorrhizae, where fungi live in association with roots of higher plants?
qHi: माइकोराइजा द्वारा किस प्रकार की पारस्परिक क्रिया प्रदर्शित की जाती है, जहाँ कवक उच्च पादपों की जड़ों के साथ सहजीवन में रहते हैं?
explainEn: Mycorrhizae represent a mutually beneficial (mutualistic) association between fungi and the roots of higher plants.

qEn: Who among the following wrote the book 'Ain-i-Akbari', which details the administration of Akbar's empire?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से किसने 'आइने अकबरी' पुस्तक लिखी, जिसमें अकबर के साम्राज्य के प्रशासन का विवरण है?
explainEn: Abul Fazl authored the Akbarnama, of which the third volume is known as the Ain-i-Akbari.

qEn: Which economic sector is primarily associated with the extraction of natural resources such as mining, agriculture, and fishing?
qHi: कौन सा आर्थिक क्षेत्र मुख्य रूप से खनन, कृषि और मछली पकड़ने जैसे प्राकृतिक संसाधनों के निष्कर्षण से जुड़ा है?
explainEn: The primary sector involves harnessing natural resources directly from the earth, including agriculture, mining, and fishing.

qEn: In macroeconomics, which of the following is considered a flow variable rather than a stock variable?
qHi: समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र में, निम्नलिखित में से किसे स्टॉक चर के बजाय प्रवाह चर माना जाता है?
explainEn: Income is measured over a period of time, making it a flow variable, whereas wealth and capital are measured at a point in time (stock variables).

qEn: Which of the following coordination compounds exhibits optical isomerism?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा उपसहसंयोजन यौगिक प्रकाशिक समावयवता प्रदर्शित करता है?
explainEn: Octahedral complexes containing symmetrical bidentate ligands, such as [Co(en)3]3+, are chiral and show optical isomerism.

qEn: What type of reaction is the combination of nitrogen and hydrogen to form ammonia in the Haber process?
qHi: हैबर प्रक्रिया में अमोनिया बनाने के लिए नाइट्रोजन और हाइड्रोजन का संयोजन किस प्रकार की प्रतिक्रिया है?
explainEn: The Haber process combines nitrogen and hydrogen gases to synthesize ammonia, making it a synthesis or combination reaction.

qEn: Which fundamental right in the Indian Constitution guarantees protection of life and personal liberty?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान में कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार जीवन और व्यक्तिगत स्वतंत्रता की सुरक्षा की गारंटी देता है?
explainEn: Article 21 states that no person shall be deprived of their life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.

qEn: In a partnership firm, the relation between the partners is that of:
qHi: साझेदारी फर्म में, साझेदारों के बीच का संबंध होता है:
explainEn: According to the Indian Partnership Act, partners act as agents of each other and of the firm, creating a principal-agent relationship.

qEn: Which historical site is associated with the Indus Valley Civilization located in Gujarat?
qHi: गुजरात में स्थित सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता से संबंधित ऐतिहासिक स्थल कौन सा है?
explainEn: Lothal is a prominent archaeological site of the Indus Valley Civilization situated in the Bhal region of Gujarat.

qEn: What does the term 'IPO' stand for in business and finance?
qHi: व्यवसाय और वित्त में 'IPO' शब्द का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
explainEn: An Initial Public Offering refers to the process of offering shares of a private corporation to the public in a new stock issuance.

qEn: Which functional group isomerism pair is possible between an aldehyde and which other organic family?
qHi: एक एल्डिहाइड और किस अन्य कार्बनिक परिवार के बीच कार्यात्मक समूह समावयवता (फंक्शनल ग्रुप आइसोमेरिज्म) संभव है?
explainEn: Aldehydes and ketones have the general formula CnH2nO and exhibit functional group isomerism with each other.

qEn: In microeconomics, what does a downward-sloping demand curve typically represent?
qHi: व्यष्टि अर्थशास्त्र में, नीचे की ओर ढलान वाला मांग वक्र आम तौर पर क्या दर्शाता है?
optsEn: Direct relationship between price and quantity demanded
Inverse relationship between price and quantity demanded
No relationship between price and utility
optsHi: मूल्य और मांग की गई मात्रा के बीच सीधा संबंध
मूल्य और मांग की गई मात्रा के बीच व्युत्क्रम संबंध
कीमत और उपयोगिता के बीच कोई संबंध नहीं
explainEn: According to the law of demand, as the price of a good decreases, the quantity demanded increases, creating an inverse relationship shown by a downward slope.

qEn: Which process of soil nutrient loss involves the downward movement of water-soluble nutrients through the soil profile?
qHi: मिट्टी के पोषक तत्वों के नुकसान की किस प्रक्रिया में पानी में घुलनशील पोषक तत्व मिट्टी की गहराई में नीचे की ओर बह जाते हैं?
explainEn: Leaching is the loss of water-soluble plant nutrients from the soil, due to rain and irrigation, washing them down into lower soil layers.

qEn: Which physical geography term describes a steep-sided, narrow, deep inlet of the sea formed by glacial erosion?
qHi: भौतिक भूगोल का कौन सा शब्द हिमनद अपरदन द्वारा निर्मित समुद्र के एक खड़ी दीवार वाले, संकीर्ण और गहरे प्रवेश द्वार का वर्णन करता है?
explainEn: A fjord is a long, narrow, deep inlet of the sea between high cliffs, formed by submergence of a glaciated valley.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography, Fundamentals of Physical Geography

qEn: What is the primary role of the enzyme DNA ligase during DNA replication?
qHi: डीएनए प्रतिकृति (रेप्लिकेशन) के दौरान डीएनए लाइगेज एंजाइम की प्राथमिक भूमिका क्या है?
explainEn: DNA ligase seals the nicks in the sugar-phosphate backbone, effectively joining Okazaki fragments on the lagging strand.

qEn: Which gland in the human body is known as the master gland?
qHi: मानव शरीर की किस ग्रंथि को मास्टर ग्रंथि कहा जाता है?
explainEn: The pituitary gland secretes several hormones and regulates other endocrine glands, earning it the title of master gland.

qEn: What is the chemical formula of glucose?
qHi: ग्लूकोज का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
explainEn: Glucose is a simple sugar with the molecular formula C6H12O6.

qEn: In which economic sector does agriculture primarily fall under?
qHi: कृषि मुख्य रूप से किस आर्थिक क्षेत्र के अंतर्गत आती है?
explainEn: The primary sector includes agriculture, forestry, fishing, and mining, which involve extracting raw materials.

qEn: In the context of macroeconomics, which of the following is considered a flow variable?
qHi: समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र (मैक्रोइकॉनॉमिक्स) के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित में से किसे प्रवाह चर (फ्लो वेरिएबल) माना जाता है?
explainEn: Income is measured over a period of time, making it a flow variable, whereas wealth, capital, and reserves are stock variables measured at a point in time.

qEn: Which phenomenon demonstrates the particle nature of light by showing that photons can transfer momentum to electrons?
qHi: कौन सी घटना यह दर्शाती है कि फोटॉन इलेक्ट्रॉनों को गति प्रदान कर सकते हैं, जिससे प्रकाश की कण प्रकृति सिद्ध होती है?
explainEn: The Compton effect involves the scattering of a photon by a charged particle, such as an electron, demonstrating that photons carry momentum like particles.

qEn: What is the primary product formed when primary alcohols are oxidized using mild oxidizing agents like PCC (Pyridinium chlorochromate)?
qHi: जब प्राथमिक अल्कोहल को पाइरिडिनियम क्लोरोक्रोमेट (PCC) जैसे हल्के ऑक्सीकरण एजेंटों का उपयोग करके ऑक्सीकृत किया जाता है, तो बनने वाला मुख्य उत्पाद क्या है?
explainEn: PCC is a mild oxidizing agent that stops the oxidation of primary alcohols at the aldehyde stage without converting them further to carboxylic acids.

qEn: Which international organization was established in 1995 as a successor to the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT)?
qHi: टैरिफ और व्यापार पर सामान्य समझौते (GATT) के उत्तराधिकारी के रूप में 1995 में किस अंतर्राष्ट्रीय संगठन की स्थापना की गई थी?
explainEn: The World Trade Organization (WTO) was officially born on January 1, 1995, under the Marrakesh Agreement, replacing GATT.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Political Science, Contemporary World Politics

qEn: Which of the following is a key feature of a socialist economy according to standard economic theory?
qHi: मानक आर्थिक सिद्धांत के अनुसार निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी समाजवादी अर्थव्यवस्था की एक प्रमुख विशेषता है?
optsEn: Collective ownership of means of production
optsHi: उत्पादन के साधनों का सामूहिक स्वामित्व
किसी भी आर्थिक योजना का अभाव
explainEn: In a socialist economy, the means of production are owned and controlled by the society or the state.

qEn: Who wrote the famous novel 'Pride and Prejudice'?
qHi: प्रसिद्ध उपन्यास 'प्राइड एंड प्रेजुडिस' किसने लिखा था?
explainEn: Jane Austen wrote 'Pride and Prejudice', published in 1813.

qEn: In which type of natural selection do individuals at both extremes of a phenotypic distribution fare better than those in the middle?
qHi: प्राकृतिक चयन के किस प्रकार में, फेनोटाइपिक वितरण के दोनों सिरों पर स्थित व्यक्ति बीच वाले व्यक्तियों की तुलना में बेहतर प्रदर्शन करते हैं?
explainEn: Disruptive selection favors extreme values over intermediate values, leading to two distinct peaks in the population distribution.

qEn: Which noble gas has the highest boiling point among the group 18 elements?
qHi: समूह 18 के तत्वों में से किस उत्कृष्ट गैस का क्वथनांक सबसे अधिक होता है?
explainEn: As we move down group 18, atomic size increases, van der Waals forces become stronger, and the boiling point increases, making radioactive Radon the highest.

qEn: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for the establishment of a Supreme Court of India?
qHi: भारत के संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद भारत के सर्वोच्च न्यायालय की स्थापना का प्रावधान करता है?
explainEn: Article 124 of the Indian Constitution states that there shall be a Supreme Court of India constituting a Chief Justice of India and other judges.

qEn: What type of economy is characterized by the central planning authority making decisions regarding production and distribution?
qHi: उत्पादन और वितरण से संबंधित निर्णय लेने वाले केंद्रीय नियोजन प्राधिकरण की विशेषता किस प्रकार की अर्थव्यवस्था में होती है?
explainEn: A centrally planned or command economy is one where a central government authority controls production, investment, prices, and incomes.

qEn: In double-entry bookkeeping, what is the primary rule regarding the recording of transactions?
qHi: डबल-एंट्री बहीखाता पद्धति में, लेनदेन को दर्ज करने से संबंधित प्राथमिक नियम क्या है?
optsEn: Every transaction affects only one account
Every transaction has a dual aspect of debit and credit
Transactions are recorded only when cash is received
Only liabilities and assets are recorded
optsHi: प्रत्येक लेनदेन केवल एक खाते को प्रभावित करता है
प्रत्येक लेनदेन के डेबिट और क्रेडिट दोनों पहलू होते हैं
लेनदेन तभी दर्ज किए जाते हैं जब नकद प्राप्त होता है
केवल देनदारियां और संपत्ति दर्ज की जाती हैं
